chunks: And the Messenger of Allah, peace be upon him and his family, said:

There is no pilgrim who remains reciting the talbiyah until the sun passes its zenith except that his sins depart with it, and hajj and 'umrah drive away poverty just as the bellows remove the impurity from iron.

key_terms.الْحَجُّ: the pilgrimage to the Sacred House
key_terms.الْكِيرُ: the bellows or furnace tool used in purification
key_terms.مُلَبِّيًا: one reciting the talbiyah during pilgrimage

ai.seo_question: How do hajj and 'umrah affect sins and poverty according to hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith highlights the spiritual and worldly blessings of hajj and 'umrah. It teaches that sincere pilgrimage brings forgiveness of sins and that hajj and 'umrah are also a means through which poverty is repelled by Allah, just as fire and bellows purify iron.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2238 - The Messenger of Allah (swt), peace and blessings be upon him and his family, said:

"There is no pilgrim who continues reciting the Talbiyah until the sun passes its zenith except that their sins disappear along with it. Hajj and Umrah drive away poverty just as the bellows remove impurities from iron."
